title: Cupcake
cn: 第 16 集 · 纸杯蛋糕
novel:
It began as an ordinary Tuesday and became, by accident, a perfect one.

Ted found a hat that suited him, met a kind stranger, and bought a warm [[cupcake|cupcake]] from a tiny [[bakery|bakery]]. The [[frosting|frosting]] was thick and [[irresistible|irresistible]]. He [[nibbled|nibble]] slowly to [[savour|savour]] it, then [[indulged|indulge]] and ate two more, leaving [[crumbs|crumb]] all over his coat like a [[greedy|greedy]] child.

That afternoon his boss offered him a [[promotion|promotion]]: a better [[salary|salary]], a five-year [[contract|contract]], and total [[stability|stability]].

It was a real [[opportunity|opportunity]]. It was also a [[dilemma|dilemma]].

Taking it meant giving up his [[ambition|ambition]] to design one beautiful building of his own. Refusing it meant [[risk|risk]], and a very good chance of failure.

He kept the hat, the receipt and the paper cup as [[souvenirs|souvenir]] of the day, half believing in [[superstition|superstition]], half hoping the hat was a [[lucky charm|lucky charm]].

That night the choice felt [[overwhelming|overwhelming]]. But Ted had learned something from the [[bargain|bargain]] price of a cupcake: small joys are cheap, and big dreams are not meant to be.

He said no to the contract. He kept the hat.

cupcake.en: a small cake baked in a paper cup

bakery.en: a shop that makes and sells bread and cakes

frosting.en: the sweet soft layer on top of a cake

irresistible.en: so good that you cannot say no

savour.en: to enjoy something slowly and fully

indulge.en: to let yourself have something you enjoy, maybe too much

crumb.en: a very small piece of bread or cake

promotion.en: moving up to a better job in the same company

salary.en: the money you are paid for your job each month

stability.en: the state of staying safe and not changing

opportunity.en: a good chance to do something

dilemma.en: a hard choice between two things

ambition.en: something big you really want to achieve

risk.en: the chance that something bad may happen

souvenir.en: a small thing you keep to remember a place or day

superstition.en: the belief that certain things bring good or bad luck

lucky charm.en: an object people believe brings good luck

overwhelming.cn: 压倒性的；令人难以承受的
overwhelming.en: so strong or big that you cannot deal with it
